phases.title: Welcome aboard, Argonauts.
phases.body:
You are Argonauts aboard Odyssey, Worldline’s rocket, heading for North Star.

You run North Star Supply,
the onboard shop.

The shop has products and customers.
It still has no checkout.

We need a payment system to show the fees and check which payment methods are allowed.

You lead the mission.
AI helps build the payment system.

Time to recruit AI
as our co-builder.

phases.title: What is a Large Language Model?
phases.body:
• A large neural model trained to predict the next token.
  • Training learns parameters.
  • Chat uses them—it does not retrain the model.
phases.notes: Opening definition and mechanic image. No diagram-step counter: the following topics are separate slides.

phases.title: What is an AI agent?
phases.body: A goal-driven model-and-tools loop. Persistent memory and RAG are optional.
phases.notes: The agent is a goal-directed system, not the model alone. Tool execution, current context, observations and a runtime/control loop support action. Persistent memory and RAG are optional. The brain/limbs analogy is illustrative; long-term memory is not required for every autonomous task. User-generated cutaway is placed under the annotated SVG overlay. Annotation positions follow the requested composition and need presenter visual confirmation; no browser check was run.
phases.visibleText: A goal-driven model-and-tools loop. Persistent memory and RAG are optional. Anatomy of a tool-using AI agent A robot with a brain in a glass jar: the LLM selects actions, tools act, a runtime manages the feedback loop, and current context holds messages and results. Persistent memory and retrieval are optional attachments. Goal + instructions Tools Runtime / loop LLM Current context Memory (optional) RAG (optional) Task + constraints Read, edit, execute, call APIs Act → observe → repeat Choose the next action Messages, state, results Durable information Retrieve external knowledge

phases.title: Connect a chat model with LangChain
phases.body:
Choose one provider. Reuse the client in your agent.

OpenAI

from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
llm = ChatOpenAI(api_key=API_KEY, model="<openai-model-id>")

Mistral · workshop client

from langchain_mistralai import ChatMistralAI
llm = ChatMistralAI(api_key=API_KEY, model="ministral-8b-2512")

OpenRouter

from langchain_openrouter import ChatOpenRouter
llm = ChatOpenRouter(api_key=API_KEY, model="provider/model-id")
phases.notes: These are mutually exclusive illustrative choices, not three clients to run sequentially. llm matches the following create_agent example. Each provider needs its own secret represented by API_KEY; secrets are loaded securely, never hard-coded. OpenAI and OpenRouter model IDs are placeholders: select an available tool-capable model for agents.
